claims: Jessie Buckley won the 2026 Oscar for Best Actress for her performance in Hamnet.
The Best Actress nominees included Jessie Buckley, Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I'd Kick You), Kate Hudson (Song Sung Blue), Renate Reinsve (Sentimental Value), and Emma Stone (Bugonia).
The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
